fields.description: Turn on the camera scanner in the mobile app. With this off the app falls back to search, which is slower and more error prone.
fields.label: Enable Barcode Scanning

fields.description: Items can only reach an invoice by scanning. Use where mis-keyed item codes have been a real problem.
fields.label: Require Scan to Add an Item

fields.description: Allow typed item search as well as scanning.
fields.label: Allow Manual Item Search

fields.description: If a scanned code matches no barcode, try it as an item code. Warehouse labels often print the code rather than a registered barcode.
fields.label: Fall Back to Item Code

fields.description: How long the app may be used after the last successful sign-in before it forces a fresh online login.
fields.label: Offline Sign-in Window (Hours)

fields.description: A queued document older than this is flagged to the user instead of syncing silently.
fields.label: Max Queue Age (Hours)

fields.description: Stamp latitude and longitude on every document posted from the field.
fields.label: Capture GPS on Post

fields.description: Readings less accurate than this are stored but marked unreliable.
fields.label: Acceptable GPS Accuracy (Metres)
Allow Negative Stock in Van Warehouses

fields.description: A negative position older than this escalates to management.
fields.label: Clearing Window (Hours)

fields.description: Cap on the value that may sit negative, as a percent of the item's stock value.
fields.label: Value Cap (%)

fields.description: A van cash or cheque sale carries its payment on the invoice itself, so one document is posted and it comes back Paid with nothing outstanding. This marks the invoice as POS, which is what makes ERPNext post the cash to the ledger. Turn it off to post the invoice and a separate receipt instead.
fields.label: Record Payment on the Invoice

fields.description: Collections a driver takes against invoices raised earlier always stay in draft for the cashier, whatever the setting beside this. The person holding the cash should not also close the books on it.
fields.label: Driver Collections Stay Draft

fields.description: Customers created on the phone stay disabled until someone with the Van Sales Manager role approves them.
fields.label: Customer Creation Needs Approval

fields.description: Refuse a credit sale that would take the customer past their limit. Cash settlement is always allowed.
fields.label: Block Credit Sales Over Limit
